parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the input dF/F traces.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the input dF/F traces.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: estimate_parameters
parameters.description: Whether to estimate parameters, in particular the sparsity parameter lam, using the noise constraint, or to use the parameters provided explicitly.
parameters.help_text: Whether to estimate parameters, in particular the sparsity parameter lam, using the noise constraint, or to use the parameters provided explicitly.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Exponential decay time in seconds (1/e, thus equal to half-life time divided by ln(2)). Estimated from the autocovariance of the data if no value is given. Has to be provided explicitly if estimate_parameters is False.
parameters.help_text: Exponential decay time in seconds (1/e, thus equal to half-life time divided by ln(2)). Estimated from the autocovariance of the data if no value is given. Has to be provided explicitly if estimate_parameters is False.

parameters.name: tau_rise
parameters.description: Exponential rise time in seconds (1/e, thus equal to half-rise time divided by ln(2)). Zero selects an AR1 model; any other value selects AR2.
parameters.help_text: Exponential rise time in seconds (1/e, thus equal to half-rise time divided by ln(2)). Zero selects an AR1 model; any other value selects AR2.

parameters.name: optimize_tau
parameters.description: Number of large, isolated events to consider for further optimizing tau. No optimization if optimize_tau is 0.
parameters.help_text: Number of large, isolated events to consider for further optimizing tau. No optimization if optimize_tau is 0.

parameters.name: baseline
parameters.description: Fluorescence baseline value. If no value is given, the baseline is optimized when estimate_parameters is True, else 0.
parameters.help_text: Fluorescence baseline value. If no value is given, the baseline is optimized when estimate_parameters is True, else 0.

parameters.name: baseline_nonneg
parameters.description: Enforce a strictly non-negative baseline if True.
parameters.help_text: Enforce a strictly non-negative baseline if True.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.description: Standard deviation of the noise distribution. If no value is given, sn is estimated from the data based on power spectral density.
parameters.help_text: Standard deviation of the noise distribution. If no value is given, sn is estimated from the data based on power spectral density.

parameters.name: lam
parameters.description: Sparsity penalty parameter. If no value is given, lam is estimated as the optimal Lagrange multiplier for the noise constraint under L1 penalty when estimate_parameters is True, else 0.
parameters.help_text: Sparsity penalty parameter. If no value is given, lam is estimated as the optimal Lagrange multiplier for the noise constraint under L1 penalty when estimate_parameters is True, else 0.

parameters.name: s_min
parameters.description: Minimal non-zero activity within each bin (minimal spike size).
parameters.help_text: Minimal non-zero activity within each bin (minimal spike size).

parameters.name: no_qc
parameters.description: Skip generation of the per-ROI QC plots.
parameters.help_text: Skip generation of the per-ROI QC plots.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
